title: A pendulum at rest and at its extremes

steps.say: At rest the bob hangs straight down on its 1 m string.
At the left extreme the string is 20° from vertical; the bob is h = 1 m × (1 − cos 20°) = 0.060 m, about 6.0 cm, above its lowest point.
At the right extreme, 20° the other way, it is again 6.0 cm above its lowest point.
